data.title: Alhisn Maze Opens amid Excitement and Competition at Riyadh Season
data.content:
Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Alhisn Maze opened yesterday at Alhisn Studios in Riyadh as part of the seventh edition of Riyadh Season.
    The event attracted visitors who took on its various challenges in an atmosphere of excitement and competition, navigating obstacles and collecting points to qualify for the final stages.
    The experience features a series of challenges beginning with a points-based stage, followed by elimination rounds leading to the decisive Castle challenge.
    It includes 12 challenges that test strength, speed, balance, and teamwork, including climbing slippery stairs and walls, navigating obstacles over water, and crossing muddy water before time runs out.
    The elimination rounds allow only one participant to advance to the Castle challenge, where the competition reaches its final stage. The finalist is crowned the winner upon reaching the top of the Castle.
    Riyadh Season, in its seventh edition, continues to offer events across various venues in the capital, bringing together international sporting events, concerts, and theatrical performances, alongside interactive experiences and entertainment activities.
    -- SPA
19:16 Local Time 16:16 GMT
